mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal dysfunction; fluconazole may increase amphotericin B levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, potentiating toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely with baseline and frequent serum creatinine/BUN measurements; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antifungal if possible; amphotericin B lipid formulation may reduce nephrotoxicity risk.
